title: Open Food Log v0: nutrients
description: The nutrient keys a food or a meal may carry. Each key names its unit, so a number never travels without one. infoods is the FAO INFOODS tagname the key corresponds to (null where none matches exactly), fdc_nutrient_number is USDA FoodData Central's nutrient number, and health_connect and healthkit name the matching Android NutritionRecord property and HealthKit quantity type identifier (null where the platform has none). v0.1: 52 keys, checked 2026-11-12 against the FAO/INFOODS tagnames, FoodData Central's nutrient list, and the Health Connect and HealthKit references. Draft; may change until v1.

nutrients.name: Energy
nutrients.notes: Metabolizable energy. INFOODS reports ENERC in kJ by default; 1 kcal = 4.184 kJ.

nutrients.name: Energy, kilojoules
nutrients.notes: The same energy as energy_kcal, in kilojoules, as EU and Australian labels declare it beside kcal. Give either or both; a reader converting uses 1 kcal = 4.184 kJ, though labels compute each from their own factors, so the two may differ slightly.

nutrients.name: Trans fat
nutrients.notes: HealthKit has no trans fat identifier.

nutrients.name: Alpha-linolenic acid (ALA, 18:3 n-3)
nutrients.notes: FoodData Central's 851 is the all-cis form; INFOODS F18D3N3 is any 18:3 n-3, slightly broader.

nutrients.name: Carbohydrate
nutrients.notes: Total carbohydrate by difference, as US and Canadian labels and FoodData Central give it. Fibre is included. Net carbs is carbohydrate_g minus fiber_g, computed when read and never stored.

nutrients.name: Carbohydrate, available
nutrients.notes: Carbohydrate without fibre, as EU, UK and Australian labels declare it. INFOODS CHOAVL- is available carbohydrate by an unknown or mixed method. Health Connect's totalCarbohydrate and HealthKit's dietaryCarbohydrates don't say which basis, so writers to them should send carbohydrate_g where it's known.

nutrients.name: Added sugars
nutrients.notes: On US labels since 2020. INFOODS SUGAD is from the 2008 additions to the tagname list.

nutrients.name: Polyols (sugar alcohols)
nutrients.notes: Sugar alcohols. INFOODS recommends mg for POLYL; the quantity is the same.

nutrients.name: Sodium
nutrients.notes: Salt on an EU label is sodium × 2.5.

nutrients.name: Salt
nutrients.notes: Sodium chloride as EU and UK labels declare it (sodium × 2.5). INFOODS NACL and FoodData Central's 375 are in mg.

nutrients.name: Manganese
nutrients.notes: INFOODS reports MN in µg by default.

nutrients.name: Iodine
nutrients.notes: INFOODS ID is iodide, iodine as a synonym.

nutrients.name: Chloride
nutrients.notes: FoodData Central names 302 Chlorine; INFOODS CLD is chloride.

nutrients.name: Vitamin A, retinol activity equivalents
nutrients.notes: RAE, as US labels and FoodData Central give it. INFOODS VITA_RAE is defined in the FAO/INFOODS Guidelines for Food Matching (v1.2), not the tagname lists; plain VITA uses the older retinol equivalents and is not the same number. Neither Health Connect nor HealthKit names the form. IU converts on input only (section 4 of the spec).

nutrients.name: Vitamin D (D2 + D3)
nutrients.notes: Micrograms, not IU (1 µg = 40 IU).

nutrients.name: Vitamin E (alpha-tocopherol)
nutrients.notes: Alpha-tocopherol, as US labels have given it since 2020 (INFOODS VITE is alpha-tocopherol equivalents, a different number). Neither platform names the form.

nutrients.name: Vitamin K (phylloquinone)
nutrients.notes: Phylloquinone (K1), as FoodData Central's 430. Neither platform names the form.

nutrients.name: Niacin (B3)
nutrients.notes: Preformed niacin (INFOODS NIA), not niacin equivalents (NIAEQ).

nutrients.name: Vitamin B6
nutrients.notes: INFOODS VITB6A is by analysis; VITB6- is the same nutrient by an unknown method.

nutrients.name: Folate, dietary folate equivalents
nutrients.notes: Dietary folate equivalents, as US labels give folate (1 µg folic acid = 1.7 µg DFE). Health Connect's folate and HealthKit's dietaryFolate don't say whether they mean DFE.

nutrients.name: Folic acid
nutrients.notes: Synthetic folic acid alone, which US labels may declare in parentheses beside folate. Health Connect has folicAcid; HealthKit folds folic acid into dietaryFolate.

nutrients.name: Choline, total
nutrients.notes: Neither Health Connect nor HealthKit has choline.

nutrients.name: Alcohol (ethanol)
nutrients.notes: Grams of ethanol. Health Connect has no alcohol field, and HealthKit's numberOfAlcoholicBeverages counts standard drinks, not grams, so neither matches.

nutrients.name: Water
nutrients.notes: Water in foods and drinks (hydration is water_g summed over everything eaten and drunk). HealthKit's dietaryWater and Health Connect's HydrationRecord are water drunk, by volume, so neither matches; plain water logged as an item of ofc:water may be written to them.
